title: What came between Kingdom of Brycheiniog and Principality of Wales?
question: What came between Kingdom of Brycheiniog and Principality of Wales?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Kingdom of Brycheiniog (450) to Principality of Wales (1216): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
